description: This is the 1st Age of the game! It starts with access to 1 divine power :favoraom: and some basic buildings, such as House :aomr_house_icon:, Temple :aomr_temple_icon: and resource collection places. Your start is important to define the pace of the match, so choose wisely based on the (Rush :aggro_icon:, Turtle :turtle_icon: or Eco :eco_icon:) strategy!

requisitos_para_subir_de_era: Temple (Greek), Temple (Egyptian), Temple (Norse), Temple (Atlantean), Temple (Chinese), Temple (Japanese)
description: From here we can choose 1 of 2 minor gods (with passive, myth units, god power, and exclusive technologies). We have access to the first huts to train troops. Depending on your strategy, put into practice your Rush :aggro_icon:, Turtle :turtle_icon: or Eco :eco_icon:!
Generally necessary to have more destructive power for buildings in the fortress :aomr_fortress_icon: (using siege units :aomr_type_siege_weapon_icon:) or to access more powerful troops.

requisitos_para_subir_de_era: Fortress, Migdol Fortress, Hill Fort, Palace, Baolei, Castle
description: This era is usually reached in longer or more boomy (strategy of only economy) matches. The divine powers very powerful here and the troops even more so!
hint: Common: time of 15-30 minutes, but it really depends!

description: Very rare to happen in matches! When you build the :aomr_wonder_icon: Wonder, your :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: mythic units become stronger and divine powers are cheaper and quicker to reuse. The match has to be very close for someone to risk this, but it is a possible strategy to win the match!
hint: Rare: May occur more in (TG) team matches or all matches against (FFA)
